venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Fri 9/11 (MOD JK).** Net $6,728 vs $6,389 target (105%); food $524; comps: none reported; 236 guests / $28.51 avg. Very rainy start but a flow of guests at open; closers in at 8 followed by a nice-size birthday group; DJ Jamie started a little after 9pm. No barback — team worked well together and got out from behind the bar. Chill night with a steady flow but no big push before midnight; reminder to suggestive-sell during down times. Kitchen: prepare for chill nights. No 86s, no incidents, no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: large birthday group kicking off the night. (Note: form was submitted twice — the second entry had target/food/comps mistyped; the first, complete submission was used.)

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Fri 9/11 (MOD KE / Chef JMS).** Net $9,574 vs $10,745 target (89%); food $225; comps $204 (2.1%); 365 guests / $26.23 avg. A decent though somewhat slower Friday — slower start, then steady from 8 until 12:30, dropped off, small pop from Charmers guests just before 1am. Regulars plus new faces, several birthdays, a handful of folks dancing. Kitchen: smooth sailing. 86: Guinness keg (cans in the meantime). No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: meeting Oku's newest bartender Adam who popped in for a CCOF.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Fri 9/11 (AM Maggie H; PM Carey & Rachel).** Total net incl. events $18,362.18 vs $16,839 target (109%); DC/AM $1,399.96, D&C PM $16,962.04, Garden/6A $5,073.84; food $3,087; no events; comps $475 (2.59%); 333 guests (Tock) / ~$55.14 avg. AM: very smooth day, a couple of IRDs; Rishi rep Ali came back around and Kelly stopped by for media shots. PM: busy night with lots of celebrations, though energy petered out fairly early. Garden: steady evening with great weather. Kitchen: slower Friday with a good pop around 8. Break make-up complete; no-shows not charged. **Incident/injury reported: Yes** (no detail given). Maintenance: left curtain by table 22 needs professional cleaning. Favorite moment: a guest came up just to say how blown away she was by the service — first-timers turned regulars.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Stunning, subtly cool — 'weather was a headwind' early
venues.narrative: **EV — Fri 9/11 (MOD Kyler / Chef Steves).** Total EOD net $7,848 vs $8,006 target (98%); food $797, beverage $7,052; no events; comps $253.18; 230 guests (SevenRooms) / $34 avg. Early slow start as people enjoyed the sun; after sunset filled out with heavy mid-top flow — lots of dates, 4 large-ish parties, 8 solos, 9 investor cocktails. Regulars Sara and Sandeep in researching their canned-cocktail line. Door: handful inside early, full by 7:30, small waitlist from 8 (cleared by 9), rebuilt at 10 to medium (~1hr waits), a few still waiting at close. A massive NYFW show next door drew ~80 people outside with some trying to sneak in; after-party seekers late. New locals Cole, Julia, Sandeep; Macallan rep Pete Crawley, member Kenan, investor Buck, member Rider Foster; several Seattle visitors. Top sellers: Rosalie, Night Letters, Shinebox. Kitchen: olive/pickle tins should be larger. Breakage: 1 DOF chip, 1 sidecar. Menus 18. No-shows (2, at 12am and 12:30am) charged.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Fri 9/11 (MOD Gigi/Julian/Joe/Josh/Angel/Saleh).** Net $10,818 vs $11,491 target (94%); Marquee $8,210, Standing Room $2,608; food $1,999; comps $184 (Bailey, Jeff Kang, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL); 297 guests / ~$36.42 avg (form typed $90.16). Pretty steady Friday: 112 covers on the books, mellow first hour vs a typical Friday, room filled with walk-ins and resos by ~7:30 shortly after Standing Room opened; busiest 7–9pm with great pace, never overwhelming. Gracy training on the floor with Jaz. Both rooms active until ~11:30 when the waitlist cleared and every walk-in was taken. Bailey stopped by with friends for his birthday. Kitchen: everything came out looking great. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: Jeff bought pizza for the staff at end of night.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Fri 9/11 (MOD Marcus / Josh).** Total net incl. events $7,975 vs $9,110 target (88%); Marquee bar $7,452.25, Garden $764.75, total sales $8,217; food $897; comps $242 (voids $52); 190 guests / $33.51 avg (check avg $74.83). Slow start given the beautiful weather and 'Art All Night' happening across the city; picked up ~7:45 with a steady mix of resos and walk-ins through ~11:30, then a lull through last call. Garden: first guest seated ~6:45, picked up ~8:30 with a couple of larger parties, mostly two-tops; last call ~9:45 and guests moved inside to fill the Marquee. Focus areas: ticket pacing, pulling menus, attentiveness, checking in with MOD, BOH closing SOPs (bar/server teams had a lot to reset). Kitchen: light night, a couple of larger group orders. Kitchen close not checked. Maintenance: curtain rail. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: industry friends with gifts; D&C fans from NYC.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Hot day; rain from 5pm, big downpour ~7:30, rain rest of night
venues.narrative: **MG — Fri 9/11 (AM Sam & Lex/Shannon; PM Justin & Shannon/Marcus/Drew).** Total net $10,504 vs $11,265 target (93%); Municipal Bar AM $1,385 (46 guests), PM $7,630 (130 guests), Sun Club $481, Hot Eye $1,876; food $3,689; no events; comps $224; 176 guests (OpenTable) / ~$59.68 avg. Morning: quiet with a steady brunch push, 3 food tours of ~10 each, no IRD. Evening: ran with three servers (one under comfort zone) — pace allowed it; bar took its first table (large party at T50); reso block at 6:30/7:30, then big rain for an hour before walk-ins resumed; drinks push after 10; Earl solo-closed with Madi's support. Sun Club: hot and sunny until storms washed everyone out by 5pm; good hotel-guest showing. Hot Eye: steady then busy with guests escaping the rain, tapered off ~10:30; late visit from Lee (Murrell's Row). Kitchen: uneventful, rain kept people out; 86 romanesco (back tomorrow). No incidents. Favorite moment: Murrell's Row Spirits rep surprising the team for a nightcap with James.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Fri 9/11 (MOD Julian Abel).** Net $14,189 vs $10,000 target (142%); food $1,902; comps $800 (surprise & delights / DNL / guest recovery — acknowledged as very high, team to be more selective); 308 guests / $46.07 avg. What a shift: team tried to slow down to speed up, but once reservations were in they filled the place; C + M crushed the door; Curtis out at a decent hour; many friendly industry folks. Better communication across the board, smoother and smoother; need to connect on compendium drinks/ingredients (JA to check). Kitchen did almost $2k — crushed it. Maintenance: still need to talk to MB about one of the regulators. 86: CLM, cookies, crab salad. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: everyone's smiling faces closing the bar after a hard shift.
